name: smwmusic-kottpower-red-brinstaralternate
title: Kottpower - Red BrinstarAlternate
description:
An aetherial track composed by kottpower, intended as an alternative version for Super Metroid's Red Brinstar (even though it fits Maridia more IMO) and used in various Super Metroid hacks like Contamination and Arcade.

This version is an AMK port of Metaquarius's port for Super Metroid so credits in porting goes to him (and the composition naturally to kottpower), I (MarioFanGamer) was only responsible for porting it to AMK. The only other major difference is that a version without flowing water is included for aesthetics purposes and potentially technical reasons.
